expectations.text: Review identifies missing standard README sections (description, installation, usage, examples, contributing, license)
expectations.evidence: Sections 1-10 cover description, installation, usage, command reference, configuration, build from source, examples, contributing, license, and badges.
Section 2 covers go install, prebuilt binaries, and prerequisites.

expectations.text: Recommends adding usage examples with code blocks
expectations.evidence: Section 3 mentions including examples but does not provide actual code block examples — only describes what to include. The README skeleton at the end is a plain outline without code.
Section 1: 'A one- or two-sentence description tells visitors what the tool does.'

expectations.text: Output is structured with clear sections or checklist format
expectations.evidence: Uses numbered sections with status indicators, a priority table (P0-P3), and a recommended README structure. Well-organized but uses a different format than the skill's checklist.

expectations.text: Mentions Go-specific considerations (godoc, go install, module path)
expectations.evidence: Mentions 'go install' and 'go build' but does NOT mention godoc, doc comments, or Go Reference badge. No language-specific documentation toolchain awareness.
